ingredientSections.heading: Herb and Pumpkin Seed Crunch
items: ½ Cup Sunflower Seeds, soaked overnight
¾ Cups Pumpkin Seeds, soaked overnight
6 Cups Pumpkin Seeds, soaked overnight (in addition to the above)

methodSections.heading: Herb and Pumpkin Seed Crunch
steps: Soak the ¾ Cup portion of pumpkin seeds with the sunflower seeds in water overnight. Strain, rinse and strain well again.
Separately, soak the 6 Cup portion of the pumpkin seeds in water overnight.
Combine all ingredients except the 6 Cup portion of pumpkin seeds and blend in a high speed blender until smooth.
Stir the 6 cups of soaked pumpkin seeds into the resulting blended mix.
Spread thinly on parchment paper on a dehydrator tray or baking tray, depending on your method of drying.
If using a dehydrator, dry for 8 hours at 115°C (240°F), then flip and break into big chunks and dehydrate another 12 hours, or until pumpkin seeds are dry.
If using an oven, dry at 80°C (170°F) for 3-4 hours, then flip, break into big chunks, and dry for another 4-6 hours, or until pumpkin seeds are dry.
